final: WITH per_invoice AS (SELECT invoice_number, AVG(CAST(product_quantity AS REAL)) AS avg_quantity, AVG((derived_product_cost - derived_total_cost) / NULLIF(derived_total_cost, 0)) AS avg_cost_ratio FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_quantity) AS overall_avg_quantity FROM per_invoice) SELECT p.invoice_number, p.avg_quantity, p.avg_cost_ratio, p.avg_quantity - o.overall_avg_quantity AS quantity_difference FROM per_invoice AS p CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE p.avg_quantity > o.overall_avg_quantity ORDER BY quantity_difference DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
